title: RichtextArea: maxlength calculation problem
author: gerhard-moser
body_preview: The length that is displayed in the counter below the richtext area differs in certain cases from the length that is used for validation.  e. g.   counts as 1 character in the displayed counter but as 6 characters for validation.
